title: Panel Level Element Token
description: The default color for ui elements on the side panel level is too close to the background color and tree items, tab labels, etc are not readable unless hovered. Add per-level element-foreground token family, give panel level readable rest-state value, emit data-level on panel roots.
summary: Added per-level element-foreground token family (--element-base through --element-temporary) mirroring the existing --hover-* pattern. Panel level uses darker/lighter readable grays (--color-dark-5-9 light, --color-gray-600 dark) via [data-level] scoping rules. PanelGhostRoot now emits data-level from useLevel() so side panels, generic panels, and mobile panels scope the token to tree items and tab labels at rest. Non-panel levels remain on --color-gray; navbar, canvas, and window-options are unaffected.
